text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah...! So this is Kyoto Racecourse! 
Awesome, the vibe here is incredible~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"To think I'd dedicate my first away race 
to the Shuka Sho instead of the undeniably 
fiery Kikuka Sho... It caught even me by 
surprise. But you know—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
—This year's Tiara route is way too 
intense! I'll never, ever be able to 
forget that "Oka Sho"...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
It's a pity about Cesario-chan, but... I'm 
sure all the other girls will show us a 
race like that again today...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
—That's all the flowers for Heart-san! 
I'll go hand them out to the other runners 
now!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, there's a card tucked inside. 
'Victory is yours.' ...Hehe."
choice_data_list: They sure are enthusiastic, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I never imagined it would become 
quite this exciting...
choice_data_list: Didn't see that coming, did you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, yes. I mean, the Kikuka Sho 
is next week, right? —And 'she' is running 
in it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this year's Classic Triple Crown trail, 
one Umamusume stood out above all the 
rest. With her shocking strength, the 
entire Umamusume world has turned its eyes 
toward her.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I thought it couldn't be helped if I were 
hidden in the shadow of all that frenzy. 
But...
choice_data_list: I can feel the heat of your racing.
The passion from your race is reaching us

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's what makes racing so fantastic! 
When we run with our hearts ablaze... 
everyone truly embraces it.
choice_data_list: And those cheers will fire you all up.
And those cheers will fire you all up.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's give-and-take— We influence each 
other, that's racing!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm getting more and more excited! 
Don't you think today is just the perfect 
day?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"The greatest rivals, and the crowd is in 
peak condition! And on top of that—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I can challenge it as a perfected version 
of myself. ...Isn't that right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Daring Heart is in peak form right 
now. She's at her absolute best, without a 
doubt. However... an undeniable reality 
still stands.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. And yet, that gloomy look on your 
face... You're worried about the distance 
after all, aren't you?
choice_data_list: ...I think it'll be a tough battle.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Probably more than anything... I've 
ever experienced before.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, the me of today— enjoys it 
precisely because it's so harsh.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's painful, I won't give up 
until the very end— I'll show you I can 
hang on!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"After all, I've prepared everything to 
make today as fun as possible!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Daring Heart is here... to clash 
hearts with the greatest rivals on the 
greatest stage."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, isn't there something else you 
wanted to say to me?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Let me hear your words. —So that this 
heart may take flight.
choice_data_list:
This is the final race for the dream 
Triple Tiara

This is the final race for the dream 
Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That's right.
choice_data_list:
Go out there and live your youth to the 
fullest!

Go out there and make the most of your 
youth!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Keep your eyes on me! Don't look 
away—until the very last step!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah...!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Do your best, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"—We're finally at the last leg, huh. The 
world of the Triple Tiara we've dreamed 
of..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. Like it or not, this is the end...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“—In that case, let my name be carved into 
history, and bring down the curtain.”

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"With today's victory... I will clear my 
mother's stained name. My mother wasn't 
merely 'almost good enough'—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I will carve into history with my very 
name... that you were truly strong...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know. How strong you are. ...How 
amazing you all are.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... I want to carve my mark, too! 
I want my name to echo far beyond the 
Tiara, into the distant future...!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose. —The Shuka Sho will be 
mine!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! Did you all forget who the star of 
today is?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Of course, how could I ever forget? 
Heart-san—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Your strength reminded me. Of just how 
wonderful the blood flowing through my 
veins truly is..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I will not lose. No matter how 
freely you run—I will run you down.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san! Being able to run all the way 
here side-by-side with you... was so much 
fun!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's clash with everything we've got 
until the very end! Just like the racers 
we looked up to...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Both of you...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Yes... Just like the queens I 
looked up to that day—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
We'll engrave our magnificent, beautiful 
running... into the "here and now"!
